---
title: "Dengue 登革热"
---

## 全国登革热月度报告病例数 · Monthly reported dengue cases in China

本页展示中国疾控中心《法定传染病疫情概况》月度报告中的**登革热报告病例数**（全国，整数计数）。
月报通常在次月 2–3 周后发布，因此图中最新月份为最近一个已完整报告的月份。
预测页的新冠/流感为周频指标，登革热为月频指标，故单独在本页展示。

Data source: China CDC monthly notifiable infectious disease surveillance report, via the
[China Infectious Disease Forecast Hub](https://github.com/dailypartita/China-Infectious-Disease-Forecast-Hub)
(`target-data/time-series.csv`, target `mo inc dengue cases`).
Model forecasts for this target will appear here once teams begin submitting monthly dengue predictions.

::: {#dengue-chart-container}
:::

```{=html}
<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.35.2.min.js" charset="utf-8"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var TS_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dailypartita/China-Infectious-Disease-Forecast-Hub/main/target-data/time-series.csv";
  var container = document.getElementById("dengue-chart-container");
  container.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888">加载数据中 · Loading data…</p>';

  function parseCSV(text) {
    var lines = text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
    var header = lines[0].split(",");
    var idxDate = header.indexOf("target_end_date");
    var idxTarget = header.indexOf("target");
    var idxObs = header.indexOf("observation");
    var rows = [];
    for (var i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
      var cols = lines[i].split(",");
      if (cols[idxTarget] === "mo inc dengue cases") {
        rows.push({ date: cols[idxDate], value: Number(cols[idxObs]) });
      }
    }
    rows.sort(function (a, b) { return a.date < b.date ? -1 : 1; });
    return rows;
  }

  fetch(TS_URL)
    .then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
      return r.text();
    })
    .then(function (text) {
      var rows = parseCSV(text);
      if (!rows.length) throw new Error("no dengue rows");

      var latest = rows[rows.length - 1];
      var peak = rows.reduce(function (m, r) { return r.value > m.value ? r : m; }, rows[0]);

      container.innerHTML =
        '<div style="display:flex;gap:2rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:.5rem">' +
        '<div><div style="font-size:.8rem;color:#888">最新报告月份 · Latest month</div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:600">' + latest.date.slice(0, 7) + "：" + latest.value.toLocaleString() + " 例</div></div>" +
        '<div><div style="font-size:.8rem;color:#888">历史峰值 · Peak</div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:600">' + peak.date.slice(0, 7) + "：" + peak.value.toLocaleString() + " 例</div></div>" +
        "</div>" +
        '<div id="dengue-plot" style="width:100%;height:420px"></div>';

      Plotly.newPlot("dengue-plot", [{
        type: "bar",
        x: rows.map(function (r) { return r.date; }),
        y: rows.map(function (r) { return r.value; }),
        marker: { color: "#c0392b" },
        hovertemplate: "%{x|%Y-%m}: %{y:,} 例<extra></extra>"
      }], {
        margin: { t: 20, r: 20, b: 50, l: 60 },
        xaxis: { title: "月份 · Month", type: "date", dtick: "M3", tickformat: "%Y-%m" },
        yaxis: { title: "报告病例数 · Reported cases", rangemode: "tozero" }
      }, { responsive: true, displaylogo: false });
    })
    .catch(function (e) {
      container.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#c0392b">数据加载失败（' + e.message + "），请直接查看 " +
        '<a href="' + TS_URL.replace("raw.githubusercontent.com", "github.com").replace("/main/", "/blob/main/") + '">hub 数据文件</a>。</p>';
    });
})();
</script>
```

::: {.callout-note}
登革热预测任务（`mo inc dengue cases`，horizon -1 至 3 个月）已在 hub 中开放提交，
reference_date 为每月 1 日。各模型团队开始提交月频登革热预测后，本页将叠加展示预测区间。
:::
